description: React component for admin console user management actions menu, including user role management, activation, deactivation, password reset, MFA removal, LDAP sync, and other user settings.

methods.name: getTranslatedUserRole
methods.description: Returns a localized string representing the user's role status (Deactivated, System Admin, Guest, Member).

methods.name: handleManageRolesClick
methods.description: Opens modal to manage user roles and updates user roles on success.

methods.name: handleManageTeamsClick
methods.description: Opens modal to manage user teams.

methods.name: handleManageUserSettingsClick
methods.description: Opens modal to manage user settings with confirmation.

methods.name: handleManageTokensClick
methods.description: Opens modal to manage user access tokens.

methods.name: handleResetPasswordClick
methods.description: Opens modal to reset user password.

methods.name: handleRemoveMfaClick
methods.description: Resets user's MFA and updates user state.

methods.name: handleSwitchToEmailPasswordClick
methods.description: Switches user's auth service to email/password.

methods.name: handleUpdateEmailClick
methods.description: Opens modal to update user's email.

methods.name: handlePromoteToMemberClick
methods.description: Promotes guest user to member role.

methods.name: handleActivateUserClick
methods.description: Activates user account if not LDAP.

methods.name: handleDeactivateMemberClick
methods.description: Deactivates user account if not LDAP.

methods.name: showResetFailedAttempts
methods.description: Determines if reset login attempts option should be shown based on user properties.
